findings.title: Reversed outgoing group-velocity sign

Right vector u_wt', adjoint pairing normalized to1
Analytic Bloch family exactly D(d+nu)^2+c(d+nu)+F'
Hypothesis2 explicitly requires the (2.14) quantity negative
findings.decisive_evidence: Exact differentiation gives lambda'(0)=K=2<uad,Duwt''>+c; (2.13) requires cg=-K while (2.14) gives cg=K. Literal K<0 reverses spatial root derivative needed in Proposition3.1.

findings.title: Critical resolvent decomposition lacks required cancellation
hypotheses_checked: Same periodic Floquet coefficients and simple neutral projection
Frozen-coefficient integral retains nu(lambda) exponential
Nonconstant wave gives nonzero translation mode
Smooth compactly supported forcing can pair nontrivially with adjoint mode
findings.decisive_evidence: Printed sc=-K0-Klambda reconstructs resolvent with residual -2K0, not zero; p45 requires an extra lambda which is absent. (6.28) adds r+(r-w)+(w-q)=2r-q instead of q. Lwt uwt=((1-2a)u^2-2u^3,0) is nonzero for nonconstant wave, so Lemma6.10 q0=uwt is false.
findings.core_dependency: Lemma7.4 residual gain -> Theorem7.1 faster residual -> Section9 bootstrap.
findings.impact: Central decomposition and the claimed cancellation are false as printed; no nonlinear-instability example claimed.

findings.title: Wrong Green-kernel signs falsify Appendix A remainder estimate
hypotheses_checked: Actual smooth bounded front coefficients, c>0, b0<=0, epsilon gamma>0
Choose b>0 within permitted strip and large positive Omega
Nonzero real phi in C_c^infty; U=(0,phi); g=(Lfr-b-iOmega)U
p=2 is allowed; g is compact smooth and complexification of asserted real-input bound valid
Correct diagonal inverse norm estimates imply high-frequency resolvent exists
findings.decisive_evidence: Both printed kernels have distribution delta coefficient -1. For g above, printed v0=-phi exactly, v1,v2=O(Omega^-1), whereas actual v=phi. Remainder tends to2phi but asserted C Omega^-3/2 ||g||=O(Omega^-1/2) tends to0.
findings.core_dependency: False LemmaA.4 explicit expansion used in contour shift -> PropositionA.5/4.3 -> Theorem7.1.
findings.impact: Actual permitted test-data family disproves the printed central high-frequency remainder, not the nonlinear theorem after correction.
findings.repair_verification: Negate each diagonal Green kernel. Terms with odd number of inverse factors reverse, even number do not. Local normalization and counterexample proved; full corrected contour argument not certified.
findings.severity_basis: Substantive estimate in the proof is actually false, despite a potentially short symbolic correction.

findings.title: Impossible uniform L1-to-highest-derivative resolvent bound
hypotheses_checked: Fixed small positive real sigma inside prescribed sector
Odd weighted L1 data h=sgn(x)|x|^-1/2 on0<|x|<1
Also smooth odd Schwartz sequence h_n=n^2 x exp(-n^2 x^2) with uniformly bounded weighted L1 norm
Lplus-sigma^2 maps W2,infty x W1,infty boundedly into Linfty
findings.decisive_evidence: Claim would make unbounded h bounded. Smooth sequence has L1=1, first moment sqrt(pi)/(2n), Linfty=n/sqrt(2e), contradicting uniform operator composition bound. Differentiation of first-order kernel includes delta input term.
findings.core_dependency: Claimed regularity upgrade in AppendixB; downstream commutator only uses first derivative of first component and Lemma6.16 only Linfty.
findings.impact: False extra regularity; this issue alone does not invalidate the main decay rate.
findings.repair_verification: Weaken to W1,infty x Linfty in stated sector or add input Linfty for highest derivatives; local kernel and differential equation justify this boundary.
findings.severity_basis: The excessive derivative order is not required in the identified downstream uses.

findings.title: Local exponential-weight and L2-power inconsistencies
hypotheses_checked: 0<a<1/2 and epsilon sufficiently small positive
Positive leading-edge weight convention
Half-line decaying exponential in a fixed sigma sector
findings.decisive_evidence: At epsilon0 eta=sqrt(a(1-a))>0 and continues positively, contrary to printed eta_lin<0. Integral exp(-2sigma x)=1/(2sigma), so norm scales sigma^-1/2, not sigma^-1.
findings.core_dependency: Local statements; later weight construction and Lemmas6.8/6.15 use intended signs/powers.
findings.impact: Local incorrect wording/power, with no additional damaged main conclusion established.
findings.repair_verification: Use eta_lin>0 and L2 norm sigma^-1/2=lambda^-1/4; explicit scalar computations retained.
findings.severity_basis: Correct conventions are already used in the main subsequent estimates.

problems_checked.P1: Confirmed Major under the printed Bloch convention D(partial+nu)^2+c(partial+nu)+F': differentiation gives lambda'(0)=K=2<u_ad,D u_wt''>+c. Combining the source's lambda=-c_g*nu with its printed c_g=K gives the opposite sign. Fourier packets have velocity -K, so the outgoing condition requires K>0 in that convention; the inverse expansion agrees with the corrected sign. Primary read the relevant source and rederived this algebra. No actual front satisfying inconsistent hypotheses or counterexample to nonlinear stability is manufactured.
problems_checked.P2: Confirmed Major on the actual cancellation chain. From the displayed resolvent -K_lambda+se and principal -K_0, the residual must be K_0-K_lambda; the printed negative sum leaves -2K_0 at lambda=0. The neutral projection is nonzero for admissible forcing, so this is not a harmless identically-zero coefficient. Source p45 uses an O(lambda) factor to obtain faster decay, feeding Theorem7.1 and the p54 bootstrap. Also checked the displayed modal split giving 2r-q rather than q, the translation mode u_wt' rather than u_wt, and the first-order forcing g2/c. The local corrections do not certify the whole propagated nonlinear proof.
problems_checked.P3: Confirmed Major. The printed positive heat-type Green kernel has derivative jump -1, and the transport kernel also produces -delta. With the actual smooth front and U=(0,phi), lambda=b+i*Omega, fixed admissible positive b, the forcing has norm O(Omega), while the correct large-frequency diagonal inverses give existence by Neumann control. The printed approximate second component tends to -phi and its later terms are O(Omega^-1); the exact component is phi. Therefore the error tends to 2phi, contradicting the stated O(Omega^-3/2)||g||=O(Omega^-1/2) remainder. The real-data formulation extends to complex data with a fixed factor. The defect feeds the actual Appendix A/linear semigroup/nonlinear chain; it is not a constructed unstable front.
problems_checked.P4: Confirmed Minor with all domain hypotheses, including oddness and weighted L1 input. At a fixed positive spectral parameter, L_+-sigma^2 maps the claimed W2,infinity x W1,infinity target into Linfinity, whereas admissible odd L1 forcing can be unbounded. Smooth odd h_n=n^2*x*exp(-n^2*x^2) has L1 norm1, first absolute moment sqrt(pi)/(2n), and unbounded sup norm n/sqrt(2e), so smoothness does not repair a uniform bound. The highest Green derivatives retain the unsmoothed forcing. Actual downstream commutators need only W1,infinity x Linfinity; the separate L2 bound is retained. This restricted verified repair supports Minor and does not prove a global decay failure.
problems_checked.P5: Confirmed Minor. At epsilon=0 the leading-edge double-root weight is +sqrt(a(1-a)), remaining positive for sufficiently small positive epsilon, contrary to the local printed negative sign. The half-line L2 norm of exp(-sigma*x) is (2Re sigma)^-1/2, not its square. The later lemmas use the correct half power. Added an explicit Problem5 environment for this already existing finding; no new scientific accusation or severity change.
